Hearing months without being there is one thing but that means little without the context of how many kWh was used, which is what you are being billed for. It's how many kW per hour you are using, summed up for an entire month. Some devices like incandescent lamps have parasitic draw (sometimes called ghost power) which is how much power is drawn off the wall just to plug it in. 

On your heating-cooling system something to understand. It depends on how they are wired. If they are wired correctly you have both a heat and cool mode built into your home heater unit. The cool mode is the blower running with the heater section shut off, some even have speed control. It does also require a decent thermostat but they can be had for the same price as teh cheap ones if you don't mind an old fashion segmented screen.
